results.title: ECDSA Curve Origins
results.description: Claude recovered the generation process behind the NIST prime-curve seeds.
results.caveat: The findings make deliberate backdoors less plausible; they are not a proof of their absence. Some skipped candidates, the B-163 seed, and several base-point origins remain unexplained.

results.title: Skipjack S-box Origins
results.description: Claude recovered the generation process for the Skipjack cipher S-boxes.
results.caveat: Independent reproduction confirms 173/256 entries using srand48(48571). The remaining 83 entries can be reconciled with 52 entry swaps derived from the official table, but the sources do not specify a rule for choosing those swaps. This supports a relationship to the generator, not a complete recovery of the historical design process or a conclusion about backdoors. Claude attribution is reported by the linked authors, not independently established by the experiment. See experimental/skipjack/README.md.
